form.label: Cisco WLC 9800 + CURWB Telemetry Dashboard
form.description: Monitoreo Catalyst 9800 mediante Model Driven Telemetry y monitoreo CURWB/URWB mediante Cisco URWB Telemetry Protocol.

search.query: index=$index_tok$ sourcetype=cisco:wlc9800:telemetry host=$wlc_host_tok$ | spath
index=$index_tok$ sourcetype=cisco:wlc9800:telemetry host=$wlc_host_tok$ | spath
index=$index_tok$ sourcetype=cisco:urwb:telemetry
index=$index_tok$ sourcetype=cisco:urwb:telemetry

search measurement="Cisco-IOS-XE-wireless-client-oper:client-oper-data/common-oper-data" | bin _time span=1s | eventstats max(_time) as last_snapshot | where _time=last_snapshot | stats count as clientes

search measurement="Cisco-IOS-XE-wireless-access-point-oper:access-point-oper-data/capwap-data" | bin _time span=1s | eventstats max(_time) as last_snapshot | where _time=last_snapshot | stats count as activos | eval total=activos | eval APs=activos." / ".total | table APs

search measurement="Cisco-IOS-XE-process-cpu-oper:cpu-usage/cpu-utilization" | eval cpu=coalesce('fields.cpu_utilization','fields.five_seconds') | where isnotnull(cpu) | stats latest(cpu) as cpu | eval cpu=round(cpu,1)

search measurement="Cisco-IOS-XE-memory-oper:memory-statistics/memory-statistic" | eval total='fields.total_memory' | eval used='fields.used_memory' | where total>0 | eval memoria=(used*100)/total | bin _time span=1s | eventstats max(_time) as last_snapshot | where _time=last_snapshot | sort 0 - total | head 1 | eval memoria=round(memoria,1) | table memoria
search measurement="Cisco-IOS-XE-wireless-client-oper:client-oper-data/common-oper-data" | bin _time span=1s | stats count as clientes by _time | timechart span=15m latest(clientes) as Clientes
search measurement="Cisco-IOS-XE-wireless-access-point-oper:access-point-oper-data/capwap-data" | bin _time span=1s | stats count as aps by _time | timechart span=15m latest(aps) as APs

search measurement="Cisco-IOS-XE-process-cpu-oper:cpu-usage/cpu-utilization" | eval cpu=coalesce('fields.cpu_utilization','fields.five_seconds') | where isnotnull(cpu) | timechart span=5m avg(cpu) as CPU

search measurement="Cisco-IOS-XE-memory-oper:memory-statistics/memory-statistic" | eval total='fields.total_memory' | eval used='fields.used_memory' | where total>0 | eval memoria=(used*100)/total | bin _time span=1s | sort 0 _time - total | dedup _time | timechart span=5m latest(memoria) as Memoria

html.p: Estado y calidad del Wireless Backhaul

search.query: head 1 | spath path=rx_stats{} output=rx | mvexpand rx | spath input=rx | stats avg(rssi_dbm) as RSSI | eval RSSI=round(RSSI,0)

head 1 | spath path=tx_stats{} output=tx | mvexpand tx | spath input=tx | eval retry_pct=if(sent_packets>0,(retries/sent_packets)*100,0) | stats avg(retry_pct) as retry_pct | eval retry_pct=round(retry_pct,2)
head 1 | spath path=rx_stats{} output=rx | mvexpand rx | spath input=rx | stats avg(mcs) as MCS | eval MCS=round(MCS,1)
head 1 | spath path=aggr_traffic{} output=traffic | mvexpand traffic | spath input=traffic | stats max(available_capacity) as Capacity
spath path=rx_stats{} output=rx | mvexpand rx | spath input=rx | eval enlace=src_ip." -> ".dst_ip | timechart span=1m avg(rssi_dbm) as RSSI by enlace limit=20
spath path=rx_stats{} output=rx | mvexpand rx | spath input=rx | eval enlace=src_ip." -> ".dst_ip | timechart span=1m avg(mcs) as MCS by enlace limit=20

spath path=tx_stats{} output=tx | mvexpand tx | spath input=tx | eval enlace=src_ip." -> ".dst_ip | eval retry_pct=if(sent_packets>0,(retries/sent_packets)*100,0) | timechart span=1m avg(retry_pct) as Retry_Pct by enlace limit=20
spath path=tx_stats{} output=tx | mvexpand tx | spath input=tx | eval enlace=src_ip." -> ".dst_ip | timechart span=1m max(failed_packets) as Failed_Packets by enlace limit=20

spath path=aggr_traffic{} output=traffic | mvexpand traffic | spath input=traffic | eval RX_Mbps=rx_wlan_kbps/1000 | eval TX_Mbps=tx_wlan_kbps/1000 | timechart span=1m avg(RX_Mbps) as RX_Mbps avg(TX_Mbps) as TX_Mbps

spath path=aggr_traffic{} output=traffic | mvexpand traffic | spath input=traffic | eval Capacity_Mbps=available_capacity/1000 | timechart span=1m avg(Capacity_Mbps) as Capacity_Mbps by radio limit=10

head 1 | spath path=rx_stats{} output=rx | mvexpand rx | spath input=rx | eval Link=src_ip." -> ".dst_ip | eval RSSI=rssi_dbm | eval MCS=mcs | eval NSS=nss | eval Width=channel_width_mhz | eval Type=rate_type | eval Age=age_ms | table Link RSSI MCS NSS Width Type Age | rename Width as "Width MHz" Type as "PHY" Age as "Age ms"

head 1 | spath path=tx_stats{} output=tx | mvexpand tx | spath input=tx | eval Link=src_ip." -> ".dst_ip | eval Retry_Pct=if(sent_packets>0,round((retries/sent_packets)*100,2),0) | table Link sent_packets retries Retry_Pct failed_packets mcs nss channel_width_mhz | rename sent_packets as "TX Packets" retries as "Retries" Retry_Pct as "Retry %" failed_packets as "Failed" mcs as "MCS" nss as "NSS" channel_width_mhz as "Width MHz"

head 1 | spath path=radio_cfg{} output=radio_data | mvexpand radio_data | spath input=radio_data | table radio enabled he_enabled tx_power_dbm channel_width_mhz freq1_mhz freq2_mhz scanning | rename radio as "Radio" enabled as "Enabled" he_enabled as "802.11ax" tx_power_dbm as "TX Power dBm" channel_width_mhz as "Width MHz" freq1_mhz as "Frequency MHz" freq2_mhz as "Frequency 2 MHz" scanning as "Scanning"
stats count as Eventos latest(_time) as ultimo_evento by measurement | convert ctime(ultimo_evento) | rename ultimo_evento as "Último evento" | sort - Eventos

stats count as Eventos latest(_time) as ultimo_evento latest(mesh_id) as Mesh_ID by host | convert ctime(ultimo_evento) | rename host as "CURWB Node" ultimo_evento as "Último evento" | sort "CURWB Node"
